const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Recorded controller for RoboTwin 2.0 stamp_seal (eai-standard/2.1).
+
+The controller uses only RGB-D camera observations, calibration, and measured
+robot proprioception. It detects the wooden stamp and yellow mat in the initial
+head-camera image, grasps the stamp from above/front, presses its face onto the
+mat, releases it, and withdraws the arm. The service is never reset.
+"""
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output/recorded_run")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+robot = Robot()
+
+obs = robot.get_obs(
+    cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera",
+             "observer_camera", "world_camera1"),
+    include_depth=True,
+    video="none",
+)
+obs.save(str(OUT / "initial"))
+state = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def camera_points(rgb, depth_mm, calibration):
+    """Back-project selected image pixels using the supplied CV calibration."""
+    fx = float(calibration["intrinsic_cv"][0][0])
+    fy = float(calibration["intrinsic_cv"][1][1])
+    cx = float(calibration["intrinsic_cv"][0][2])
+    cy = float(calibration["intrinsic_cv"][1][2])
+    ext = np.asarray(calibration["extrinsic_cv"], dtype=np.float64)
+    rotation, translation = ext[:, :3], ext[:, 3]
+    depth = np.asarray(depth_mm, dtype=np.float64)
+    if np.nanmax(depth) > 10.0:
+        depth *= 0.001  # RoboTwin depth frames are millimetres.
+
+    pixels = np.asarray(rgb, dtype=np.uint8).astype(np.int16)
+    red, green, blue = pixels[..., 0], pixels[..., 1], pixels[..., 2]
+    rows, cols = np.indices(red.shape)
+
+    # The yellow target is the saturated patch on the left side of the initial
+    # head image; the crop excludes the brown stamp and robot links.
+    mat_mask = ((red > 145) & (green > 120) & (blue < 90) &
+                (np.abs(red - green) < 100) & (cols < 110) &
+                (rows > 70) & (rows < 150))
+    # The wooden stamp is orange-brown, right of the mat in the initial view.
+    stamp_mask = ((red > 85) & (red > green * 1.08) &
+                  (green > blue * 1.15) & (red < 245) &
+                  (cols > 105) & (cols < 165) &
+                  (rows > 80) & (rows < 150))
+
+    def world_median(mask):
+        v, u = np.where(mask & np.isfinite(depth) & (depth > 0.25) & (depth < 1.5))
+        if len(u) < 20:
+            raise RuntimeError("camera color segmentation found too few pixels")
+        z = depth[v, u]
+        camera_xyz = np.stack(((u - cx) * z / fx,
+                               (v - cy) * z / fy,
+                               z), axis=1)
+        world_xyz = (camera_xyz - translation) @ np.linalg.inv(rotation).T
+        return np.median(world_xyz, axis=0)
+
+    return world_median(stamp_mask), world_median(mat_mask)
+
+
+stamp_xyz, mat_xyz = camera_points(
+    obs.last["head_camera"], obs.depth["head_camera"][0],
+    obs.meta["cameras"]["head_camera"],
+)
+stamp_xy = stamp_xyz[:2]
+mat_xy = mat_xyz[:2]
+print("camera-estimated stamp xy", stamp_xy, "yellow mat xy", mat_xy)
+
+
+def checked_submit(action, note):
+    global state
+    result = robot.submit("ee_pose", action, video="none", note=note)
